description: Multilingual expert in Logistics and Supply Chain, both emergency and non-emergency, with 7+ years of field experience in highly volatile regions (DRC, Chad, South Sudan, Haiti, Nigeria) and 3+ years in Finance, Administration, HR and Audit & Compliance. Holder of a Bachelor's + 5 years in Business and Financial Sciences / Accounting track, in addition to a Master's degree in International Cooperation and Humanitarian Aid (KALU Institute). I design agile procurement and logistics strategies, reference procedure manuals/SOPs and data management and analysis tools — from epidemic response to decision support for SMEs and International Humanitarian Organizations.
